note: One change against mpsenet_remix50: half of the remixed items take their noise from ESC-50 folds 1-4 (1,600 clips that are not course data) instead of another train pair. So 50 % of the items are as recorded, 25 % course speech + course noise, 25 % course speech + ESC-50 noise. From scratch, no pretrained weights. Fold 5 is the newnoise evaluation split and is not in the pool.
